headline: Argentina Central Bank Gross Reserves Fall Below $50 Billion After IMF Debt Payment
summary: Despite purchasing $42 million, Argentina's Central Bank saw its gross international reserves drop below $50 billion following a debt repayment to the International Monetary Fund.
why: Central bank reserve levels and multilateral debt service payments are critical indicators of external solvency and foreign exchange liquidity for emerging economies.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Multilateral debt repayments drain gross foreign exchange reserves despite ongoing central bank purchases.
